en.headline: AFCD says every dog attack is one tragedy too many after Yuen Long death
en.dek: Assistant director Jackie Yip pledged to tackle stray dogs at source through registration, vaccination and desexing, as joint capture operations continue in the Pok Wai area.
body: An assistant director of the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, Jackie Yip, said on Tuesday that every dog attack is one tragedy too many, vowing to address the stray-dog problem at its source after a 27-year-old woman was fatally attacked while cycling in Yuen Long on Saturday.

Three dogs linked to the case have been caught, two of them microchipped, and officers are following up with the registered owners. Yip said the incident was very unfortunate and serious, and that if stray dogs were responsible the government had a duty to protect public safety.

She said the focus is on cutting stray-dog numbers through mandatory registration, vaccination and desexing, together with public education against abandonment. In the short term, authorities would target black spots with capture operations and step up enforcement against owners. The joint operation with police in the Pok Wai South Road area would continue for some time.

zh.headline: 漁護署：每宗狗隻襲擊都是悲劇 將從源頭處理流浪狗
zh.dek: 助理署長葉嘉明周二表示會透過強制登記、疫苗及絕育從源頭減少流浪狗，壆圍一帶聯合捕捉行動會持續。
body: 漁農自然護理署助理署長葉嘉明周二表示，每宗狗隻襲擊都是一場悲劇，承諾從源頭處理流浪狗問題。事件源於周六晚一名27歲女子在元朗騎單車時疑被狗隻襲擊身亡。
與案件有關的三隻狗已被捕捉，其中兩隻已植入晶片，署方正跟進聯絡畜養人。葉嘉明形容事件非常不幸及嚴重，若確定與流浪狗有關，政府有責任保障公眾安全。
她表示重點是透過強制登記、疫苗注射及絕育減少流浪狗數目，並加強公眾教育防止遺棄。短期內會針對黑點展開捕捉行動，並加強對狗主的執法。與警方在壆圍南路一帶的聯合行動會持續一段時間。
